title: Ritual Dagger
summary: Hit with the dagger or sacrifice blood to gain +1d4 to attacks and saves.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 Piercing plus applicable ability modifier. Simple one-handed, 5 ft, Finesse, Light, Thrown and Dippable.
fields.Pain Maiden’s Blessing: Damage with the dagger adds 1d4 to your attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn, despite the tooltip. Does not stack with Bless. A Tenacity hit from a dual-wielded flail or morningstar can trigger it on a miss.
fields.Blood Sacrifice: Bonus Action on yourself. Take 1d4 nonmagical Slashing and gain the same blessing. Creates a 3 ft radius Blood surface. Some riders increase the self-damage. Slashing damage reduction works. It creates normal Blood even with Unstable Blood.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage on hit. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Healing clears it. Standard mode hits add 2 Piercing. Honour Mode adds 2 of the original damage type to any damage source.
fields.Acquisition: Abdirak carries it or leaves it near his table in the Shattered Sanctum.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
